question: How can I return an item?
answer: Start a return from the Orders page within 30 days of delivery. The item must be unused and include original packaging. Keep the return reference for tracking.

question: When will my refund arrive?
answer: After the returned item passes inspection, refunds are initiated to the original payment method. Allow 5 to 7 business days after initiation for the payment provider to post the refund.

question: Can I cancel an order after it ships?
answer: Orders that have shipped cannot normally be cancelled. You may request a return after delivery if the item meets the return conditions.

question: How do I track my shipment?
answer: Open Orders, select the order, and choose Track shipment. Tracking updates may take up to 24 hours after dispatch.

question: My package is late. What should I do?
answer: Check the tracking page first. If tracking has not changed for 48 hours after the estimated delivery date, contact support with the order reference.

question: What should I do if an item arrives damaged?
answer: Photograph the damaged item and packaging, then contact support within 48 hours of delivery. Do not discard packaging until support responds.

question: How do I change my delivery address?
answer: An address can be changed before the order is packed. Open Orders and check whether Edit address is available; otherwise contact support promptly.

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: Confirm the billing details and available balance with your payment provider. Do not send card numbers or security codes to support. Try another approved payment method if needed.

question: How can I reset my password?
answer: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page. Follow the reset link sent to your registered email. Never share the reset link or one-time code with another person.

question: I cannot sign in to my account.
answer: Check that the email address is correct and reset your password if needed. If the account remains locked after the reset, contact account support for verification.

question: How do I contact a human support agent?
answer: Use the Help section and select Contact support. Include a short description and order reference, but never include passwords or full payment-card details.

question: Can I return a final-sale item?
answer: Final-sale items are not eligible for change-of-mind returns in this demonstration policy. Items damaged in transit should still be reported to support for review.

question: What if I received the wrong item?
answer: Keep the item and packaging, take a photo of the item label, and contact support within 7 days of delivery so the issue can be reviewed.

question: Are weekend days counted for refunds?
answer: The refund estimate is expressed in business days, so weekends and public holidays are not counted.

question: How do I update my email address?
answer: Open Account settings and choose Update email. Complete the verification steps sent to your current and new email addresses.

question: I was charged twice for one order.
answer: Check whether one entry is a pending authorisation. If both charges are posted, contact payment support with the order reference and transaction dates; do not send full card details.

question: Can I change an item after placing an order?
answer: Changes may be possible before packing begins. Check the order page for Edit options or contact support immediately.

question: The tracking page says delivered but I did not receive it.
answer: Check the delivery location and ask household members or building reception. If the parcel is still missing, contact support with the order reference for an investigation.

question: How do I report a suspicious message?
answer: Do not click links or share passwords or one-time codes. Forward the message using the official security-reporting option in the Help section.

question: What details should I include in a support request?
answer: Include the order reference, a concise description, relevant dates, and non-sensitive screenshots if appropriate. Never provide passwords, one-time codes, or full payment-card details.
